lean.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ),     let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let a : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O
    let p : ℝ := (n : ℝ) / 2
    (∀ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => Real.exp (-a O * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 4)) volume) ∧
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det *
        (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-a O * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 4))) ((Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) ∧
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) / (a O) ^ p) ((Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det *
        (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-a O * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 4)) ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) /
      (2 * Real.pi) ^ p =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (Real.sqrt κ - 1) ^ (n - 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ p) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) / (a O) ^ p ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))))
approved_definition_context: Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) R is the full real orthogonal group, with the inherited finite real matrix topology and its Borel sigma-algebra, allowing both determinant signs. Compactness and second countability are supplied internally.
Measure.haarMeasure on top is the actual normalized Haar measure on the whole compact group and has total mass one; it is not an arbitrary measure, special-orthogonal law or conditional law.
EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) carries its Euclidean norm and canonical volume. Its real dimension is n. An integral with no explicit measure in this statement uses this volume.

All displayed lets are literal abbreviations. The first coordinate is the zero-based index0, whose membership proof follows from the dimension inequality. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative real square root. Real powers have real exponent p=(n:R)/2; sign powers n-1 have natural exponents.

Integrable denotes actual absolute Bochner L1 integrability under the displayed measure. The proposition explicitly includes spatial integrability for every matrix and both indicated outer Haar integrability conclusions; it is an identity for the displayed iterated integral itself.
